failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test and sw-intent-analysis-test exited 1, likely due to missing/invalid API credentials or environment setup rather than a code regression
failures.fix: Check test logs for these two suites for auth/env errors and gate them on required secrets or fix the underlying assertion

failures.root_cause: Pipeline stage tests expect artifacts (plan.md, review.md) and non-zero exit paths that the mocked build/plan/review stages never write, and one intelligence test's jq call receives non-numeric complexity output
failures.fix: Fix mock stage scripts to write plan.md/review.md artifacts before stage completion and sanitize the complexity value passed to jq in the low-complexity intelligence test

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test failed due to a stale pipeline lock from a prior run left in 'running' state, blocking the new test pipeline from starting; sw-intent-analysis-test failed because analyze_intent's generated JSON is missing required schema fields (version, goal, criteria)
failures.fix: Clear/release stale pipeline locks before test runs (or have the test suite call 'shipwright pipeline abort'/force-unlock in setup) and update analyze_intent to always emit version, goal, and criteria fields per the schema

failures.pattern: Testing meta-loop can detect declining accuracy... [38;2;248;113;113m[1mFAIL[0m: No meta-loop warning/revert event emitted for declining accuracy
failures.root_cause: Meta-loop declining-accuracy detector doesn't emit a warning/revert event when accuracy trend degrades, so the test assertion for that emitted event never matches
failures.fix: Wire the accuracy-trend check in the meta-loop into emit_event (warning/revert type) when a decline is detected, and ensure the test's mock accuracy sequence actually crosses the detection threshold

failures.root_cause: Multiple unrelated pre-existing test failures (intent-analysis schema validation, loop stuckness detection, project-detect caching, e2e-integration timeout) unrelated to the current change
failures.fix: Investigate and fix each failing test individually: intent schema fields, loop stuckness detection logic, project-detect cache consistency, and e2e-integration timeout cause
